robot: g1_sonic: Unitree G1 29-DoF + Dex3 hands (upstream scene_43dof.xml) tracked by the GEAR-SONIC release policy, deploy.sh --input-type zmq --zmq-host localhost sim

motion.source: IK keyframes (g1/plan_reach.py); NOT a human demonstration. Streamed as SONIC protocol v1 joint targets plus Dex3 hand targets over the same ZMQ 'pose' topic the GEM-X bridge uses

nominal_target.plan: one trajectory aimed at the nominal block pose; the block is jittered per seed (+/-2 cm) and never sensed

true_target.plan: per-seed trajectory aimed at the seeded block pose from scene.py (ground-truth pose substituted for perception, before the rollout)
